front: If inflation falls from 8% to 5%, are prices falling?
back: No. Prices are still rising, only more slowly.

front: How can you tell cost-push from demand-pull inflation in data?
back: Demand-pull: spending and output rise, unemployment falls. Cost-push: costs rise, output falls or stagnates, unemployment rises.

front: When did Zimbabwe experience hyperinflation, and what followed?
back: In 2007-2008; in 2009 the Zimbabwe dollar was abandoned for a multi-currency system.
Rising prices lead to higher wage demands, which raise costs and prices again, and so on.
